description: This file defines the ChatService class and related data models for managing chat interactions, including streaming and standard chat methods, utilizing various components like vector stores, language models, and chat engines.

classes.name: Completion
classes.description: Data model representing a chat completion response, including optional sources.

classes.name: CompletionGen
classes.description: Data model representing a streaming chat response with token generator and optional sources.

classes.name: ChatEngineInput
classes.description: Data class for encapsulating chat message inputs, including system message, last message, and chat history.

classes.name: ChatService
classes.description: Singleton class providing chat functionalities, including streaming and standard chat methods, integrating various components.

methods.name: from_messages
methods.description: Creates a ChatEngineInput instance from a list of ChatMessage objects, extracting system message, last message, and chat history.

methods.name: stream_chat
methods.description: Performs a streaming chat operation, returning a CompletionGen object with response generator and sources.

methods.name: chat
methods.description: Performs a standard chat operation, returning a Completion object with response and sources.

methods.name: _chat_engine
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate a chat engine (contextual or simple) based on parameters.
